description: Agent Accountability: submit an agent identity setup: the issuer, the kind of identity, who holds its keys, how another party verifies it, its export, who can revoke it, the platforms that accept it and what it carries, such as reputation or payment history, with what each is tied to. The signed report says whether the identity can be presented and verified outside the issuing platform, what breaks if the issuer revokes it or the platform closes the door, and every capability tied to a platform-kept identity with no export path. Identity record consistency is wever_agent-identity-check. Verdict platform_locked, partly_portable or portable. POST /api/identity-portability-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-accountability-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-accountability/.
